    "Securely stores and manages client project passwords for the team.",

    "Browser extension for autofill and generating strong passwords."

    "Initial setup for team organization and sharing can be less intuitive.",

    "Requires navigating a separate Admin Console for team management."

  "overall_experience": "This administrative assistant likely found Bitwarden to be a highly valuable tool for securely managing client project passwords and controlling team access, especially given its affordability. While the core functionality of secure storage and autofill was appreciated, they probably encountered some minor friction with the initial setup of team-specific features and the separation of the Admin Console from the main vault."
